content:
Hey there !

Following the recent annoucement of a Coq formalisation of busy beavers, I have started working on a reimplementation in Lean using mathlib.

The project's goal is to serve as a playground for me an others on the subject and is ready to accept contributions and feedbacks. The idea is to provide a tool to compute busy beaver numbers, as well as tools to work with specific machines.

The project is hosted on sourcehut: https://sr.ht/~vigoux/busybeaver/

The discussion channel is here: #general > Busy beaver function project annoucement
